results.rationale: Consistency: the black wall layout and gift drawings remain, with slight simplification of the bear. Instruction: a red arrow points from the bear toward the gifts but crosses the intervening walls instead of marking a valid maze route. Knowledge: Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality: the maze, illustrations and arrow are clean and structurally clear.

Consistency: the white background remains, but the small bag changes contour and position, while rope loops, knots and printed motifs are redrawn. Instruction: the right bag is only slightly reduced and remains far taller and wider than the left bag, missing the requested size match. Quality: both burlap bags have coherent woven texture, drawstrings, beads and natural shadows.
